name: Gasthof Fuchsanger
beschreibung: The Gasthof Fuchsanger is located in the municipality of Rettenschöss in the Tiroler Unterland. The accommodation offers simple but functionally furnished rooms with bathroom and toilet. The dining room and the terrace serve as common areas for guests. The surrounding area is characterized by farmland and forests. Hiking trails and ski areas are accessible from here. The atmosphere in the house is shaped by the rural surroundings. The cuisine focuses on regional products and traditional dishes.
